top_violation_types.title: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - is equipped in each vehicle (26 TAC §746.5625(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The van for transportation does not have a child safety alarm equipped.

top_violation_types.title: Written Operational Policies - Safe Sleep for Infants (26 TAC §747.501(6))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operational policy did not include infant safe sleep.

top_violation_types.title: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity (26 TAC §747.501(8))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operational policy did not include the information of indoor and outdoor physical activity.

top_violation_types.title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Transportation training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(7)(A))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Director did not have a current transportation training.

top_violation_types.title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 30 Annual Training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(6)(A))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The director did not have the required 30 hours of annual training.

top_violation_types.title: Required Admission Information - Release Information (26 TAC §746.605(7))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One child's records did not have the release information filled out.

top_violation_types.title: Health Statement on File within 1 Week of Admission (26 TAC §746.611(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Three children's files were missing healthcare professional statements.

top_violation_types.title: Required Immunizations (26 TAC §746.613(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Of the 10 children's records evaluated, one was behind with immunizations.
